global_rules.rule: Only measured system bar/display-cutout insets may be cropped; exact content viewport, no arbitrary masks.
Native pixels to CSS viewport by exact integer density BOX downsample only; native golden raw pixels unchanged.
Separate visual bounds from native touch bounds; actual native minimum 48dp.
Demo-only text/data must not ship as runtime state. Every semantic exclusion or label mapping needs named case/component, exact expected values and independent review.
Calibrate cross-renderer raster limits on independent font/platform fixture, never on mismatching production screenshot.
